engine-setup: if [ ! -d engine-runtime/vendor/vgc-bench/.git ]; then git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/cameronangliss/vgc-bench.git engine-runtime/vendor/vgc-bench; fi

git -C engine-runtime/vendor/vgc-bench fetch origin d79f9532947ac114dce1dda2456a590afcd375b2 && git -C engine-runtime/vendor/vgc-bench checkout --detach d79f9532947ac114dce1dda2456a590afcd375b2 && git -C engine-runtime/vendor/vgc-bench submodule update --init --recursive
cd engine-runtime && uv sync --group tools && uv pip install -e . && uv pip install -e vendor/vgc-bench
engine-fetch-checkpoint: cd engine-runtime && uv sync --group tools && uv run python scripts/fetch_bc_checkpoint.py --output ../checkpoints/bc-seed1-100.zip
